crew_onboarding_connect_error_host_key_c: Failure body for a changed host key; {host} is the address and the command to copy is shown below it. A security warning: keep it plain and complete.
Failure title when the server's host key differs from the remembered one.

crew_onboarding_connect_error_key_refuse.description: Failure body when the key is not authorized on the server yet. ssh-agent is the name of a program, i18n-allow glossary:agent

crew_onboarding_connect_error_key_refuse: Failure title when the server refuses the key; {key} is the key file path.
Same failure when no key path is known.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_key_still_: Failure body after a key was added and still refused. PubkeyAuthentication and ~/.ssh are sshd names and stay as written.
Failure title when the server refuses a key that Atlas just added; {key} is the key file path.
Same failure when no key path is known.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_key_unusab: Failure body on macOS and Linux when the key file has loose permissions or is not a private key.
Failure title when ssh refuses to read the key; {key} is the key file path.
Same failure when no key path is known.

crew_onboarding_connect_error_key_unusab.description: Failure body on Windows when the key file has loose permissions or is not a private key.

crew_onboarding_connect_error_name_not_f: Failure body when the name does not resolve.
Failure title when the name does not resolve; {host} is the address.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_no_key_bod: Failure body when the key file is missing.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_no_key_tit: Failure title when the key file path points to nothing.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_other_body: Failure body when the CLI gave no hint of its own.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_other_titl: Failure title for any error Atlas has no specific advice for.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_password_n: Failure body when the server takes only keys.
Failure title when sshd allows only keys.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_password_r: Failure body for a wrong password; {user} is the account and {host} the server address.
Failure body for a wrong password when no account name was typed; {host} is the server address.
Failure title when the account password is wrong.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_ssh_missin: Failure body on macOS and Linux when the ssh program is missing. The command in code stays as written.
Failure title on macOS and Linux when the ssh program is missing.

crew_onboarding_connect_error_ssh_missin.description: Failure body on Windows when the ssh program is missing; the command to copy is shown below it.
Failure title on Windows when the ssh program is missing.

crew_onboarding_connect_error_sudo_passw: Failure body when sudo asks for a password; the field is below it.
Failure title when sudo asks for a password.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_sudo_rejec: Failure body when the sudo password is wrong.
Failure title when the sudo password is wrong.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_timeout_bo: Failure body for a connection timeout.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_timeout_ti: Failure title when the connection times out; {host} is the address.
crew_onboarding_connect_error_unreachabl: Failure body for an unreachable server; the port field is above it on the form.
Failure title when the connection is refused or the network is unreachable; {host} is the address.
crew_onboarding_connect_scene_machine_co: Accessible name of the connect-step art; {machine} is the user's own computer in the words of their OS.
crew_onboarding_connect_scene_your_serve: Caption under the server in the connect-step art.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_action_pick: Button under a connect failure: opens the file picker to choose another private key.

crew_onboarding_connect_step_action_retr.description: Button under a connect failure: runs the install again.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_action_retr.distinct: says what to do after a failure; the common Retry is a verb for lists

crew_onboarding_connect_step_action_use_: Button under a connect failure: switches the form to the SSH key.
Button under a connect failure: switches the form to the account password.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_browsers_op: Label of the checkbox that also installs the screenshot browsers on the server.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_choose_a_fi: Link of the connect form when no key is found: opens the file picker.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_choose_anot: Link next to the key in use: opens the file picker to choose another private key.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_copy_comman: Accessible name of the copy button of the command shown in a failure.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_copy_instal: Accessible name of the copy button of the install command shown under Prefer the terminal.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_create_one: Link that creates an SSH key; one refers to the key named in the line before it.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_creating: Link label while Atlas creates an SSH key.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_details: Summary of the disclosure that holds the raw last line of a failure.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_how_to_fix: Link of a failure: opens the troubleshooting section of the docs.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_installed_c: Line shown when the install finished and Atlas connects to the server.

crew_onboarding_connect_step_key_file_mi.description: Line shown when the picked key file does not exist.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_key_file_mi.distinct: a line beside the form's key, not the failure title

crew_onboarding_connect_step_key_in_use: Hint under the key shown when ssh finds it by itself.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_key_kept: Hint under the key shown after the user picked another key: it is remembered for this server.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_looking_for: Line with a spinner while Atlas looks for the SSH key the form will use.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_method_key: Segment of the Sign in with control: sign in with an SSH key.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_method_pass: Segment of the Sign in with control: sign in with the account password.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_no_key: Line shown when ssh finds no private key on this computer.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_password_cr: Hint when no key exists: signing in with the password makes Atlas create one.

crew_onboarding_connect_step_password_of.description: Label and placeholder of the password field; {user} is the account name typed in the address.

crew_onboarding_connect_step_password_us: Hint under the password field: the password adds the key once and is never saved.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_port: Label of the SSH port field.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_prefer_the_: Small link that opens the same install as a command to run in a terminal.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_sign_in_wit: Label and accessible name of the control that picks the key or the password.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_ssh_address: Label of the SSH address field (user@host).
crew_onboarding_connect_step_sudo_passwo: Label and placeholder of the sudo password field of a failure.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_terminal_hi: Hint under the install command shown by Prefer the terminal.
crew_onboarding_connect_step_use_the_def: Link that drops the picked key and goes back to the key ssh finds by itself.
